code: GATE Block 1.0.0, main/GATE Block in https://github.com/xgrs8/kyc_zain
labels: the GATE Block's deterministic rules (gate_block/rules.py with config/rules.yaml and config/decision_tree.yaml) applied to each measured state; no human labels, no OCR outcomes

photos.dataset/: renders of identities 001, 004, 007, 012, 015, 019, 022, 026, 029, 034, 037 and 042 of the synthetic print run (national ID front and back, tax card, company licence), made by Z.ai's Synthetic KYC Dataset Builder; fictional people and companies, IDs without portrait
photos.real/: ten phone photos of one printed and cut-out licence of that run (identity 001): blur, clutter, finger_cover, glare, handheld, keyboard, low_light, partial, strong_perspective, table
